body:
Ok cool, fixed. Two benefits: our new default github pages (org wise) is community.algolia.com.

People trying to access algolia.github.io on purpose will be redirected to community.algolia.com (301, good for SEO too).

Solved by:
- adding a CNAME file to https://github.com/algolia/algolia.github.io
- removing the cloudflare host override (otherwise infinite redirect loop)
